characters.continuity: The Silmarillion / The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Anárion was a prince of Númenor and co-founder of the Southern Kingdom of Gondor alongside his brother Isildur. He was a formidable warrior who defended Minas Anor and Osgiliath against Sauron.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to siege machinery and overwhelming physical force

sources.supports: Founding of Gondor, defense of Minas Anor, and death during the Siege of Barad-dûr.

feats.claim: Defended Minas Anor and Osgiliath against the forces of Mordor during the War of the Last Alliance.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Rings of Power and the Third Age

notableResults.note: Held the city against initial assaults before the Siege of Barad-dûr.

unknowns: Exact details of his personal combat engagements during the Siege of Barad-dûr are sparse.

characters.summary: Ancalagon the Black was the greatest of the winged dragons created by Morgoth. He possessed immense physical size, devastating fire breath, and could blot out the sun with his wings.

mechanisms: Impenetrable dragon scales except for vulnerable underbelly

weaknesses: Vulnerable underbelly and weak spots beneath armor plating
limitations: Massive size makes him a target for aerial combatants

sources.supports: Status as the greatest dragon of Morgoth, immense size, and defeat by Eärendil.

feats.claim: Drove back the Host of the Valar from Thangorodrim before being slain.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, The Voyage of Eärendil and the War of Wrath

notableResults.citation: The Silmarillion - The War of Wrath
notableResults.note: Slain after a day-long battle in the skies above Thangorodrim.

campaignTags.claim: Had massive wings and flew in the War of Wrath
Exceeded the size of ordinary dragons and crushed mountains upon falling

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how Eärendil bypassed his defenses in aerial combat.

characters.summary: Ar-Pharazôn the Golden was the last and most powerful King of Númenor. He humiliated Sauron through military might alone, but was ultimately seduced by Sauron's counsel and led his armada to Valinor, resulting in the drowning of Númenor.
weaknesses: Arrogance, fear of death, and susceptibility to psychological manipulation by Sauron

sources.supports: Status as King of Númenor, subjugation of Sauron, and the invasion of Valinor.

feats.claim: Land an armada so vast that Sauron's armies surrendered without striking a blow.

notableResults.note: Sauron submitted voluntarily because Númenor's military force was too overwhelming.

unknowns: Exact fate beneath the falling mountains of Aman during the Downfall.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Aragorn, son of Arathorn, is the Chieftain of the Dúnedain and rightful King of Gondor and Arnor. He fights with exceptional skill using the sword Andúril, possesses extraordinary stamina, and excels in tracking and wilderness combat.

mechanisms: Elven mail and rugged travel gear

weaknesses: Vulnerable to conventional physical damage and overwhelming numbers
limitations: Human physiological limits despite enhanced Dúnedain longevity and stamina

sources.supports: Lineage as Isildur's heir, combat skills, usage of Andúril, and leadership feats.

feats.claim: Fought off five Nazgûl at Weathertop using fire and a sword.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring, A Knife in the Dark

feats.claim: Commanded the Army of the Dead at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.
feats.citation: The Return of the King, The Last Debate

notableResults.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring (Film adaptation / Book equivalent)
notableResults.note: Defeated the Uruk-hai leader in brutal hand-to-hand combat.

notableResults.citation: The Return of the King - Black Gate
notableResults.note: Stared down and unnerved the emissary of Sauron.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses the King's Foil (athelas) healing arts
Master tracker and ranger skilled in covert movement

unknowns: Exact limits of his resistance to dark magic and sorcery.

characters.summary: Aredhel the White was an Elven princess of the Noldor, sister of Turgon. She was a skilled hunter and horse-rider who ventured into Nan Elmoth and was ensnared by Eöl.
weaknesses: Overconfidence when traveling alone through perilous domains

sources.supports: Lineage as daughter of Fingolfin, skill as a hunter, and entrapment in Nan Elmoth.

feats.claim: Rode alongside the sons of Fëanor and hunted in the forests of Beleriand.

notableResults.note: Trapped in Nan Elmoth through Eöl's spells and compelled to marry him.

campaignTags.claim: Known as the White Lady of the Noldor, adept at moving unseen through forests

unknowns: Full extent of her combat record during the migration of the Noldor.

characters.summary: Arien was a Maia of Valinor chosen to guide the Sun across the skies. She possesses immense fiery power and radiant heat that even Morgoth's servants fear.
weaknesses: Bound to her cosmic task of guiding the Sun vessel
limitations: Restrained by the mandates of the Valar regarding direct intervention in Middle-earth

sources.supports: Nature as a Maia of fire, pilot of the Sun, and superiority over lesser spirits of fire.

feats.claim: Scorched dragons and Orcs who attempted to assail the Sun during its early journeys.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Sun and Moon and the Hiding of Valorin

campaignTags.claim: Navigates the heavens guiding the vessel of the Sun
Embodies primeval fire and solar energy

unknowns: Direct combat encounters against major entities like Sauron are unrecorded.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Arwen Undómiel is an Elf-maiden of Rivendell, daughter of Elrond. In some adaptations she wields a blade and commands magical river waters, while in the primary texts she functions primarily through presence, lineage, and spiritual fortitude.
weaknesses: Choosing mortality strips away her immortal Elven advantages
limitations: Physical endurance is subject to mortal limits after choosing mortality

sources.supports: Lineage as daughter of Elrond, choice of mortality, and role in the legendarium.

feats.claim: Carried Frodo across the Bruinen to escape the Nine Riders.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring (Film adaptation)

notableResults.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring - River Bruinen
notableResults.note: Swept them away using channeled river water (Film version).

campaignTags.claim: Summoned the Bruinen river torrent to wash away the Nazgûl in film adaptations

unknowns: Discrepancy between her passive role in Tolkien's novels and her active warrior portrayal in Peter Jackson's films.
